name: Aura of Life

targets.description: you and your allies while in the aura

summary: 30-foot aura: Resistance to Necrotic, Hit Point maximums can't drop, and allies at 0 HP regain 1 HP.
text: Life energy radiates from you in a 30-foot Emanation for the duration. While in it, you and your allies have Resistance to Necrotic damage and your Hit Point maximums can't be reduced. If an ally with 0 Hit Points starts its turn in the aura, it regains 1 Hit Point. Concentration, up to 10 minutes.
